prompts.prompt:
Create a premium Japanese game UI ART DIRECTION AND DESIGN SYSTEM board, landscape high resolution, beautifully typeset Japanese, generous margins, meticulous aligned grid. This is a proposed visual specification for an existing PC Unity Japanese typing roguelike about three female jailers climbing a hell tower; not a website. Title exactly 「獄の記録」 subtitle 「UIデザインガイド / 提案 v0.1」. Art direction: hell administration archive, soot black lacquer, ivory archival labels, restrained tarnished brass hairlines, vermilion official seals. Refined contemporary Japanese editorial design with subtle occult atmosphere, readable functional game UI. No generic fantasy baroque frames, no spikes, no bevel chrome, no neon rainbow outlines, no thick text strokes, no gratuitous glow. Flat matte surfaces with faint paper grain only outside body text. Main board background warm ivory, components displayed on inset near-black canvases. Use exceptionally legible Japanese typography, headings elegant Mincho, body clean Japanese gothic, roman typing monospaced. Make this a concrete beautiful design kit not a mood collage. 
Layout six clearly separated numbered modules in 3 columns x 2 rows:
01 色と役割: six large swatches exact hex + Japanese labels: #121416 墨 / 背景, #202427 鉄 / パネル, #E9E1CF 生成り / 本文, #A68B5B 真鍮 / 選択, #C94F45 朱 / 危険, #9A88BA 藤 / 狂気. Keep purple and red semantic. small note 「オーブ5色は属性専用」.
02 文字と余白: show title sample 「第六層」 40px 明朝, body 「帰還して記録を残す」24px ゴシック, huge type sample "bougyo" 44px 等幅. spacing steps 8 / 16 / 24 / 32. note 「1920 × 1080 基準」.
03 ボタン: actual 4 examples same shape subtle 4px clipped corner rectangle, 56px height, 24px horizontal padding: primary ivory fill dark text 「塔へ進む」, secondary dark fill thin brass stroke 「拠点へ帰還」, selected hovered thin ivory inner rule + small diamond pointer 「刻印を選ぶ」, disabled charcoal 「塔片が足りない」 with muted text plus lock icon. labels 「通常」「選択」「無効」. no heavy gradients.
04 テキストフレーム: actual large dark event frame with 1px brass rule and one small seal motif upper right, no ornate border. heading 「置き去りの記録」 body 2 readable lines 「扉の向こうから、紙をめくる音がする。」「足を止めて、声に耳を澄ませる。」. name tab 「エレン」 above short dialogue 「……まだ、誰かいるね。」. note 「内側余白 24 / 行間 1.6」.
05 情報の状態: two horizontal 8px bars HP 「720 / 1000」 in warm ivory and 狂気 「680 / 1000」 in muted purple, a separate red warning with icon triangle and words 「臨界まで 80」 showing do not rely solely on color; orb row red circle, blue diamond, yellow triangle, purple square, green hexagon, each flat muted jewel without glass highlights and labels. note 「形・文字・色で識別」.
06 共通ルール: three small paired visual comparisons of clean single hairline frame vs cluttered thick multi-frame; disciplined selected gold one element vs entire screen glowing; quiet background under clear text vs detailed art under text. Japanese short captions 「枠は1種類」「発光は一時的」「本文の下は静かに」.
At footer small line 「これは方向性の提案です。ゲーム内実装用の分割素材ではありません。」. Make polished professional visual production guide with actual beautiful usable-looking UI specimens. Japanese text accurate and uncluttered.
